notes: No anh ấy / cô ấy / chị ấy etc. for the player or {name}; i18n:check fails on them.
New-style tone placement (hòa, khỏe, thủy); old-style hoà, khoẻ, thuỷ fail the check.
Generated names are noun-first with a space (generatedNames: noun-first): Đỉnh + Sấm Sét = Đỉnh Sấm Sét, Lưỡi Kiếm + Song Sinh = Lưỡi Kiếm Song Sinh.
Vietnamese is outside Latin-1, so it uses the system font stack (SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS) rather than the bundled display face, which lacks the stacked diacritics.
Computer players' generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters, as in every language.
